title: List Questions
notes: Questions a student can pick: questions published by teachers (origin "teacher", newest first), then the hand-checked sample questions (origin "sample"). Rubrics stay on the server; only the question is sent. Students can also answer their own question (see 01, custom_question).

questions.title: Binary search
questions.subject: Algorithms
questions.prompt: Explain how binary search finds a value in a list. Say why the list must be sorted, how the search range changes at each step, when the search stops, and how fast it is.
